## Services / attributes / junk (owner + Toby)

Toby’s list (paraphrased, no edits made): lawn care language; honeybee/hive removal overclaim; **Home Construction**; keyword-stuffed fake services (exterminator variants, “Flea Control Jacksonville”); crawl/moisture oversold vs staffing; snake; mites bolted onto fleas; Yard Protection sounds like lawn care; no secondary categories.

**Recommendation (do not implement here):** delete non-services; rewrite description to pest/termite/WDIR/wildlife/mosquito-as-included-in-plan; add true secondary categories (Termite, Wildlife if licensed); keep crawl only if you will answer the phone for it.
